algorithm.name: Alpha-aware prototype cosine visibility
algorithm.spatialApproximation: Adaptive position bins plus quantized source-normal bins; sample original midpoint-index vertex, broadcast visibility to members
algorithm.alphaFilter: Bilinear source PNG alpha with material cutoff and UV transform; rejected hits continue

surveyedTrunkOverride.name: Assembled alpha-aware tree and soil cosine visibility
surveyedTrunkOverride.sampling: Every unique source position and normal; exact coincident-vertex sharing only

limitations: Except the 30 assembled surveyed trunks identified by assembledTrunkCorrection, receivers contain local prototype visibility, not terrain or inter-tree occlusion. No receiver contains Cycles GI or translucency.

Twelve deterministic cosine rays with at most8192 spatial/normal samples per prototype are a bounded approximation. Visibility is shared locally; vertex interpolation and fixed prototype-space radius remain approximations.
Native and LOD normals/positions match exactly; nonuniform instance scales can change true angular visibility.
No albedo, source geometry, plant placement or source PNG was changed.

options.sampling: Every unique source position and normal; exact coincident-vertex sharing only

limitations: Cosine ambient visibility only: no direct-light change, GI, color bleeding or bent normal.
Finite 32m reach and 64 deterministic rays per unique position/normal approximate visibility; actual alpha-tested tree geometry and close physical soil relief.
Exact coincident-vertex sample sharing; original per-vertex interpolation remains unchanged. No geometry or runtime shader changes.

visualQa.method: Paired frozen-source native WebGPU frames,1512x850,reduced motion; only canopy sidecar substituted
visualQa.review: Foreground surveyed trunks have stronger shaded form, retained bark texture, no broad patches or overdarkening. Deck is visually stable. Parent independently inspected and accepted the entrance comparison.
visualQa.performanceConclusion: Same shader,draws,triangles,buffers; entrance+2.66%,deck-1.44% in one pair, consistent with timing variability; no FPS improvement claimed.
